prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「垃圾」？
「bottom」的中文意思是哪一个？
选择表示「煤」的单词。
哪个单词的意思是「塑料」？
我通常步行上学。哪一句正确？

choices.text: I usually walked to school every present day.
I am usually walk to school.
I have walk to school every day.

explanation: usually 说明习惯，用一般现在时 walk。

prompt: 昨天我步行上学了。哪一句正确？

choices.text: I have walked to school yesterday.
I was walk to school yesterday.

prompt: 现在我正在步行上学。哪一句正确？

choices.text: I am walking to school now.
I walk to school now as a finished past action.
I have walked to school now in this ongoing sentence.
I am walk to school now.

explanation: now 而且动作正在进行，用 am walking。

prompt: 到上月底，他们已经种了一千棵树。哪一句正确？

choices.text: They have planted one thousand trees by the end of last month.
They had planted one thousand trees by the end of last month.
They planted one thousand trees by the end of next month.
They had plant one thousand trees by the end of last month.

explanation: by the end of last month 是过去的截止时间，用 had planted。
verify: "They had planted one thousand trees by the end of last month."

prompt: 想说不该乱扔垃圾，哪一句合适？

choices.text: We should not to throw litter on the ground.
We should not throwing litter on the ground.
We not should throw litter on the ground.
We should not throw litter on the ground.

verify: "We should not throw litter on the ground."

prompt: 想说塑料对海洋有害，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Plastic is bad for the ocean.
Plastic are bad for the ocean.
Plastic is badly for the ocean.
Plastic is bad to the ocean bottom word.

prompt: 我们可以少用煤。哪一句合适？

choices.text: We can use less coals as a countable pile.
We can to use less coal.

prompt: The river was clean before. Now there is litter at the bottom. 这句在对比什么？

choices.text: 以前干净，现在底部有垃圾

explanation: was clean 和 now there is litter。

prompt: Last year the river was clean. Now people throw plastic into it. 现在人们把什么扔进河里？
Last year the river was clean. Now people throw plastic into it. 去年河怎么样？
We should pick up litter and use less plastic. 倡议要我们做什么？
explanation: pick up litter and use less plastic。

prompt: We should pick up litter. 哪一句和倡议一致？

choices.text: The river was dirty last year.
People are asked to collect litter.

prompt: The city ___ dirty ten years ago. People have planted trees since then. 横线处选哪一个？
explanation: ten years ago 用 was。city 是单数。

prompt: We ___ not supposed to throw plastic into the river. 横线处选哪一个？
By the time the students arrived, the volunteers ___ already cleaned the park. 横线处选哪一个？
explanation: arrived 之前已经打扫，用 had cleaned。

prompt: Music that we can dance ___ makes the trip fun. 横线处选哪一个？
explanation: dance to music，关系词后保留 to。
